preconditions.description: Grid dimensions n and m are within the specified bounds.

preconditions.expression: all(cell in {'.', 'X'} for row in grid for cell in row)
preconditions.description: Each cell in the grid is either unmarked ('.') or marked ('X').

preconditions.expression: all(1 < i < n for i in range(n) for j in range(m) if grid[i][j] == 'X') and all(1 < j < m for i in range(n) for j in range(m) if grid[i][j] == 'X')
preconditions.description: No marked cell ('X') is adjacent to the grid's edge (i.e., all marked cells are at least one cell away from the border).

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == 'NO' or (stdout.strip().startswith('YES') and len(output_grid) == n and all(len(row) == m for row in output_grid))
postconditions.description: Output is either 'NO' (no solution exists) or 'YES' followed by a valid grid of integers with n rows and m columns.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == 'NO' or all(cell in {1, 4} for row in output_grid for cell in row if grid[i][j] == '.' and i < n and j < m)
postconditions.description: Every unmarked cell ('.') in the output grid contains either 1 or 4.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == 'NO' or all(output_grid[i][j] == sum(output_grid[x][y] for x, y in [(i-1, j), (i+1, j), (i, j-1), (i, j+1)] if 0 <= x < n and 0 <= y < m and grid[x][y] == '.') for i in range(n) for j in range(m) if grid[i][j] == 'X')
postconditions.description: Every marked cell ('X') in the output grid contains the sum of the numbers in all adjacent unmarked cells ('.').

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == 'NO' or all(output_grid[i][j] % 5 == 0 for i in range(n) for j in range(m) if grid[i][j] == 'X')
postconditions.description: Every marked cell ('X') in the output grid contains a multiple of 5.
